problem_title: Problem with Omniscript's Custom Lightning Stylesheet File
caption:
Problem with Omniscript's Custom Lightning Stylesheet File

🔴 The Problem: I inserted a Custom Lightning Stylesheet File into my Omniscript, but it is working not only on it, but on all page record the component is on. How to fix this? The Custom Lightning Stylesheet File :

✅ The Fix: I solved it adding flexipage-component2[data-component-id="c_myOmniscriptName"] before each tag

Originally asked on Salesforce Stack Exchange (CC BY-SA): https://salesforce.stackexchange.com/questions/427735/problem-with-omniscripts-custom-lightning-stylesheet-file
